title: Counting Treasure Cups
shareTitle: Counting Treasure Cups 🏴‍☠️ — Count Gems and Gold with Captain Goldie
description: Sail with Captain Goldie and Skipper the parrot: count gems into the golden treasure cup, sort gold coins into the chest on the beach, and work out how many treasures are hiding inside. Three counting modes for ages 4–6, driven entirely by voice, pictures and touch.
learningGoals: Count 1 to 8 with one-to-one correspondence — one number word per object
Count out a set of a requested size, and stop at the right place
Keep counting accurately while sorting by kind (coins, not gems)
Cardinality: count a set that is already there and name the total
interactionModel: The child taps or drags treasure tiles from a tray; each accepted piece arcs into a cup or chest and is visibly added to the heap while the parrot counts it aloud. In How Many? the container starts full and the child taps the matching numeral card instead. Input locks during each short flight, so rapid tapping can never over-count.
feedbackModel: Every correct piece gets pop + whoosh SFX and a spoken count; a filled pip row tracks progress without text. A wrong-kind pick wobbles in place with a parrot squawk and a spoken model of the rule — nothing is lost and nothing is scored. Completing a target glows the container, fires confetti and a spoken cheer, then offers a big play button plus a gentle auto-advance. There is no failure state and no timer.
